Title: Senior Data Scientist – AI & Supply Chain
Description:
About Accenture Data & AI For Supply Chain Team

We are a global Center of Excellence specializing in Data & AI for Supply Chain, with a rapidly growing team of 200+ professionals. Our mission is to turn data into a strategic advantage, driving operational excellence, agility, and smarter, faster decision-making across the end-to-end supply chain.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for passionate professionals to join our team and shape the future of intelligent supply chains.

Our Focus Areas



Supply Chain Planning – AI-driven demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and planning solutions to enhance agility and efficiency.

Fulfillment & Network Optimization – Advanced analytics to optimize logistics, warehouse management, distribution, network and last-mile delivery, improving speed, cost, and service levels.

Manufacturing – AI, machine learning, and IoT to drive predictive maintenance, production efficiency, and quality control in smart manufacturing.



Your role

As a Data Scientist in Accenture’s Data & AI for Supply Chain team, you will:



Apply AI, advanced analytics, and optimization techniques to solve complex supply chain challenges.

Engage directly with clients, translating business needs into AI-driven solutions and delivering measurable impact.

Drive business development, contributing to proposals, identifying new opportunities, and shaping innovative AI offerings.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including data scientists, engineers, and business consultants, to implement cutting-edge supply chain solutions



What Skills Are We Looking For?

Basic Qualifications

✔ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

✔ Proficiency in English (additional languages are a plus).

✔ 4+ years of experience in Data & AI or related fields (we are hiring at different experience levels).

Technical Skills

We seek professionals with strong expertise in AI, analytics, and optimization applied to supply chain challenges. While you don’t need to master all of them, experience in multiple areas will be highly valuable. Key skills include:



Programming: Python, R, SQL

Operation Reasearch & Simulation: LP, ILP, Heuristics/Meta-Heuristics, Discrete Events Simulation, digital twins.

Machine Learning & AI: Forecasting, predictive modeling, optimization algorithms.

Generative AI: LLMs, AI-driven scenario generation, synthetic data modeling, and workflow automation.

Cloud & Big Data: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, including AI/ML services.

Supply Chain Solutions: Familiarity with o9, Blue Yonder (BY), SAP IBP, or similar tools.

Data Engineering & Visualization: Large-scale data processing, market solutions/platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, ..), and tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.



 

Soft & Strategic Skills

Beyond technical expertise, we look for professionals who can think strategically, collaborate effectively, and drive impact in complex environments. Key skills include:



Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking: Ability to analyze supply chain challenges and design AI-driven solutions.

Business Acumen: Understanding the impact of AI and analytics on supply chain efficiency, resilience, and cost reduction.

Communication & Stakeholder Management: Ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

Agility & Innovation: Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments, with a passion for continuous learning and innovation.



 

What’s in It for You?

Join Accenture’s Data & AI for Supply Chain team and unlock a challenging and rewarding career, where you will:



Work on high-impact AI & analytics projects with global clients.

Collaborate with a team of 200+ data scientists and engineers, including 20% PhDs in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or Statistics.

Drive cutting-edge AI innovation, including Generative AI applications in supply chain.

Enjoy a flexible, hybrid work model in a Great Place to Work® recognized company.



Additional Benefits:



Comprehensive insurance (medical, life, and accident).

Wellness programs and medical services.

Flexible compensation programs & stock purchase plans.

Sustainability initiatives & Accenture Foundation programs.

Diversity & inclusion networks in a globally recognized company.

Flexibility programs (customized schedules, extra vacation days, etc.).



If you are excited about leading AI-driven transformations in supply chain, we’d love to hear from you!

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.



Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*



Your daily adventure:



Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.

Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.

Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.



Nice to Have:



Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.

Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.



Additional Information

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)



Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery).
Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
Life Insurance with AXA.
Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
Language training in English, Spanish, and French.

Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).



Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

Title: Principal Data Scientist – AI/ML and Optimization
Description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Data Science

Job Category

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Barcelona, Spain, Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States of America, Madrid, Spain, Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America, Titusville, New Jersey, United States of America

Job Description

J&J Innovative Medicine – Data, Data Science, and AI - Global Development (DDSAI GD) is recruiting a Principal Data Scientist – AI/ML and Optimization. The ideal candidate will leverage, adapt, and extend machine learning (ML), optimization techniques, and GenAI techniques to create computational pipelines supporting global clinical operations including enrollment forecasting, cost estimation and optimization, and country/site selection.

The primary location is Madrid, Spain. Other listed locations will be considered if approved by the business.

J&J Innovative Medicine develops treatments that improve the health of people worldwide. Research and development areas encompass oncology, cardiovascular and metabolic disorders, immunology, pulmonary hypertension, neuroscience, and infectious disease. Our goal is to help people live longer, healthier lives. We have produced and marketed many first-in-class prescription medications and are poised to serve the broad needs of the healthcare market – from patients to practitioners and from clinics to hospitals. To learn more about J&J Innovative Medicine, visit https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

Key Responsibilities


Conceive, develop, and implement ML, multi-objective optimization, GenAI solutions to support clinical trial operations.
Leverage operational, real-world (RWD), and cost data to develop ML models and optimization engines that support data-driven decision making across operational planning. Specifically:
Develop predictive ML models to forecast operational time-series outcomes and KPIs.
Formulate and solve optimization problems that quantify tradeoffs among competing objectives, such as cost, timelines, patient burden, quality, and operational efficiency.
Integrate predictive modeling with optimization techniques to evaluate alternative operational scenarios, assess potential outcomes, and recommend optimal strategies.
Build explainable decision-support systems that translate complex analytics into actionable insights, enabling proactive planning, early risk identification, and informed business decision making.
Adapt large language models (LLMs) for tailored information extraction and to create solutions including conducting comparative analytics on clinical trial protocols and trial similarity assessment, clinical trial data harmonization and standardization, schedule of activity optimization, and eligibility criteria evaluation
Stochastic enrollment simulations to forecast operational and patient journey outcomes including enrollment and study completion.
Clearly articulate highly technical methods and results to diverse audiences and partners to drive decision-making.
Coaches and trains junior colleagues in techniques, processes, and responsibilities.


Required Qualifications


A Ph.D. degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., computer science, electrical and computer engineering, biostatistics, health economics, biomedical informatics, applied mathematics, or similar),
5+ years of industry experience delivering on data science projects using ML predictive modeling, multi-objective optimization, natural language processing, and GenAI.
Hands-on experience with multi-modal ML predictive modeling and stochastic simulations for time-series forecasting.
Experience building multi-objective optimization engines to navigate complex trade-offs using evolutionary algorithms, reinforcement learning, or mixed-integer linear programming.
Experience with GenAI and clinical LLMs for document parsing and clinical concept disambiguation and harmonization.
Proficient in MLOps practices and tools (MLflow, Kedro); Git usage, CI/CD stacks (Jenkins, GitLab) DevOps tools.
Proficiency with programming languages Python and SQL,
Experience with python LLM tools (e.g., DSPy, LangChain), optimization tools (e.g., pymoo) and ML tools (e.g., Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Optuna, PyMc),
Demonstrated experience and familiarity with clinical operational data, real world data, electronic health records and claims, and financial data.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience in a data science AI/ML role in healthcare, MedTech, and pharmaceutical industries.
Hand-on experience utilizing clinical trial protocols, registry, cost data, CTMS, EDC and/or EHR to build ML models for estimating operational outcomes or RWE outcomes.

Title: Data Scientist F/M
Description:
Sixense Satellite, a subsidiary of VINCI Construction, is a leading player in satellite-based ground monitoring. We develop advanced technologies combining remote sensing, InSAR, and data science to deliver high-impact decision-support solutions for infrastructure management, natural hazard monitoring, and land-use planning.

As part of the VINCI Construction group, we help our clients better understand and anticipate ground deformation phenomena through Earth observation data and cutting-edge technologies.

About the Role :

Sixense Satellite is looking for a Data Scientist to join our team and contribute to the development of our Atlas InSAR (Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar) processing chain. You'll work on both maintaining and extending core processing capabilities, and on building new features that push our satellite-based ground deformation monitoring products forward.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of remote sensing, geophysics, and applied machine learning.

What You'll Do :


Contribute to the design, development, and optimization of our InSAR tools and chain
Implement new functionalities and features to expand processing capabilities and product offerings
Design and deploy machine learning models, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), for tasks such as phase unwrapping, atmospheric correction, anomaly/deformation detection, and signal classification
Work with large volumes of SAR and interferometric data, building robust and scalable pipelines
Collaborate closely with geophysicists, radar engineers, and software developers to translate research into production-ready tools
Validate model outputs against ground truth and domain expertise; iterate based on real-world performance
Contribute to technical documentation and internal knowledge sharing



What We're Looking For :


Degree (MSc/PhD) in Data Science, Computer Science, Geophysics, Remote Sensing, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
Experience in machine learning, with hands-on expertise in convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
Strong Python programming skills; experience with scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, xarray, etc.)
Experience working with geospatial or remote sensing data (SAR/InSAR experience is a strong plus, but not mandatory)
Familiarity with signal/image processing techniques
Comfortable working with large datasets and building production-grade data pipelines
Strong analytical mindset and ability to work independently on open-ended problems
Excellent written and oral reporting skills in English are mandatory.
Good communication skills and ability to work in a multidisciplinary team



Nice to Have :


French or Spanish would be a valued skill.
Prior experience with InSAR, SAR imagery, or satellite remote sensing
Experience with cloud computing platforms and distributed processing
Familiarity with geodesy or ground deformation monitoring



How to Apply ?

Interested candidates are invited to send their CV and a short cover letter to satellite@sixense-group.com with the subject line "Data Scientist – InSAR Processing Chain".

Why Join Us ?


Work on cutting-edge Earth observation technology with real-world impact — infrastructure monitoring, natural hazard detection, mining, and more
Direct influence on the evolution of our core processing chain
Collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment

Title: AI Engineer / Data Scientist
Description:
En Veltech buscamos un/a AI Engineer / Data Scientist con una sólida base en data, Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial, que quiera trabajar en el desarrollo de soluciones avanzadas basadas en IA generativa, LLMs y agentes inteligentes.

Buscamos un perfil técnico, con capacidad para entender problemas complejos, seleccionar y desarrollar los algoritmos adecuados y llevar soluciones de IA desde la experimentación hasta su implementación.

Responsabilidades


Desarrollo de soluciones de Advanced Analytics: Construcción y despliegue de soluciones basadas en Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Inteligencia Artificial.
Generative AI: Desarrollo e integración de soluciones basadas en LLMs, incluyendo prompting, embeddings, RAG y otros patrones de aplicación de IA generativa.
AI Agents: Diseño y desarrollo de agentes inteligentes capaces de utilizar herramientas, razonar sobre tareas y ejecutar flujos de trabajo de forma autónoma o semiautónoma.
Experimentación y evaluación: Evaluación de modelos y soluciones mediante métricas adecuadas, experimentación iterativa y análisis de resultados.
Data & Engineering: Preparación y transformación de datos, integración con diferentes fuentes y desarrollo de componentes necesarios para llevar los modelos a entornos productivos.
Optimización: Análisis y mejora del rendimiento, precisión y eficiencia de los modelos y soluciones desarrolladas.
Colaboración: Trabajo conjunto con perfiles de Data, Software y negocio para transformar necesidades reales en soluciones basadas en IA.


Requisitos mínimos


Experiencia profesional en Data Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering o campos relacionados.
Algoritmia: Sólida base en algoritmos, estructuras de datos, modelado y resolución de problemas.
Programación: Dominio de Python y experiencia trabajando con librerías y frameworks de Machine Learning/IA.
Machine Learning: Conocimientos sólidos de modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, así como de técnicas de entrenamiento, evaluación y optimización.
Generative AI: Conocimientos o experiencia práctica con LLMs, prompting, embeddings, RAG y/o arquitecturas basadas en IA generativa.
AI Agents: Interés o experiencia en el desarrollo de agentes de IA, tool calling, MCP, workflows/agentes autónomos o frameworks relacionados.
Datos: Buen manejo de SQL y experiencia trabajando con datos para el desarrollo y evaluación de modelos.
Producción: Capacidad para transformar prototipos y experimentos en soluciones robustas y mantenibles.


Se valorará


Experiencia desarrollando soluciones de Advanced Analytics, Generative AI y AI Agents en entornos reales.
Experiencia con frameworks de agentes y LLMs como LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex u otros similares.
Conocimientos de arquitecturas RAG, vector & graph databases y sistemas de búsqueda semántica.
Experiencia con APIs de modelos como OpenAI, Anthropic u otros proveedores.
Experiencia con Cloud, especialmente Azure.
Conocimientos de MLOps, CI/CD, Docker o herramientas de despliegue.
Experiencia previa en proyectos de forecasting, optimización o algoritmia aplicada.
Experiencia en la industria de aerolíneas.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
sennder is redefining road logistics. As Europe’s leading digital freight forwarder, we are building a smarter, faster, and more sustainable future for freight, powered by a single, unified platform that already runs our entire business. We are moving from a decade of growth through acquisition to a company that is outcome-driven, outward-focused, and AI-native by design.

Logistics is one of the best possible use cases for AI, and unlike most of our peers, we own the full loop: the platform, the operations, and the data connecting them. That closed feedback loop is a compounding advantage most competitors can’t replicate. This role exists to turn that advantage into sennder’s sharpest edge in margin, cost, and service, because AI will give us that edge if we lead, or become a risk if we lag.

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will join our highly talented ML team. This is an applied machine learning role focused on highly innovative, research-oriented topics. You will work on a diverse portfolio of high-impact projects, ranging from optimizing our established Recommendation engine & Pricing engine to building greenfield solutions. This role can be based out of our Berlin, Barcelona or Amsterdam office.

To succeed, this role demands a strong focus on deep Data Science and statistical exploration (roughly 70% of your scope), paired with the foundational Machine Learning Engineering skills (~30%) required to transition prototypes into production-ready models. You will not just be implementing technical specifications; you will sit directly with end-users, operators, and Product Managers to deeply understand their workflows, granting you real decision-making power over the product's direction. You are expected to have a holistic approach to project deployment, acting as an end-to-end ML Engineer and taking full ownership from "Light MVP" R&D to production deployment.

What You Will Do…


Pricing Engine Optimization: Develop and iterate on bid estimation algorithms and margin-optimization models to power our dynamic pricing engine, directly driving company profitability.
Carrier Forecasting: Build robust predictive models to forecast carrier behavior and market capacity, enabling our operational teams to secure the right trucks at the right price before the market shifts.
Recommender Systems: Maintain and improve our existing recommender systems to seamlessly support our operational teams' day-to-day efficiency.
Industry Innovation & Applied ML: Explore and validate new areas where machine learning can solve fundamental logistics challenges (such as freight routing and network optimization), turning open-ended industry problems into scalable, data-driven solutions.
Product Discovery & Ideation: Partner closely with Product Managers to drive continuous product discovery, translating ambiguous operational pain points into clear, outcome-driven ML hypotheses and rapid prototypes.
AI & LLM Integration: Leverage foundational models and AI agents both as daily accelerators for your own engineering workflows and as core components to build new internal products. We expect you to pragmatically evaluate trade-offs and always choose the right solution for the right problem—whether that is an LLM, a traditional ML model, or a simple heuristic.
Platform Collaboration: Partner with our Data & AI Platform (MLOps) team to utilize and deploy models via our internal ML infrastructure. You will act as a key customer of this platform, providing continuous feedback and contributions to shape our global engineering standards.
End-to-End Execution: Adopt a holistic approach to project deployment, maintaining an end-to-end attitude that covers the entire lifecycle from initial R&D and prototyping all the way through to production release and monitoring.


What We Are Looking For…


Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering.
Data Science Fundamentals: Strong foundation in statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and deep data exploration to validate assumptions and commercial viability before building complex models. You must possess a working knowledge of ML approaches to address basic regression and classification problems.
ML Engineering: Experience deploying models to production environments, writing modular code, and understanding software engineering best practices.
Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and Git. Experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake), utilizing Jupyter Notebooks for data exploration, and building interactive data apps/dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, PowerBI) to visualize outcomes for stakeholders.
AI Proficiency: A solid understanding of how to set up, evaluate, and leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and related AI tools in a production setting.
Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex & multifaceted logistical problems into data-driven solutions, prioritizing 'Outcome over Output'.
Collaboration: Strong communication skills to work closely with Product Managers, end-users, and a diverse team of ML Engineers, Data Scientists and Platform Engineers.


WHY CHOOSE SENNDER…


Impact: Build the data and AI foundation for Europe’s leading digital freight platform, at the moment sennder is shifting from buy-and-build to outcome-driven and AI-native.
Vibrant Workspaces: Our offices are equipped with healthy snacks, focus zones, and social areas to keep you energized and connected. Highlights include a slide in our Wroclaw office and a sunny rooftop terrace in Berlin, Amsterdam, and Milan.
Culture: Work in a fast-paced, hybrid environment with 1,100 talented, diverse colleagues from 74 nationalities. We prioritize well-being through initiatives like our sennCare program and a partnership with nilo.
Growth & Rewards: We believe in rewarding our team for their commitment and contributions to our long-term success. Our compensation package may include performance bonuses, referral rewards, or equity that align with our goal of building a thriving company together.


We celebrate diversity and value your character just as much as your skills. If you don’t meet every requirement, don’t worry, we still encourage you to take a chance and apply. Bring your authentic self and help us shape the future of logistics in Europe.

Please read our Privacy Policy before submitting your application.

Learn more about us on our career website.

Title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO - SnT
Description:
Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promises across hundreds of millions of packages daily? How does it decide how many trucks and how much labor are required to ship orders across the network?

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the optimization and forecasting science behind these decisions.

We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Barcelona (alternatively: Luxembourg or London) with a strong academic background in optimization, machine learning, and/or time-series forecasting.


You will design and build state-of-the-art machine learning and optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at an unprecedented scale across two core scientific pillars:
Large-Scale Optimization and Planning: Designing planning systems for order assignment and resource utilization, while balancing multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to enable controllers to steer millions of shipments per hour optimally.
Demand Forecasting & Predictive ML: Developing time-series forecasts for customer demand, incorporating contextual information (weather, sales, order properties), and modeling uncertainty for core planning systems.


Basic Qualifications


PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
Research experience in one or more:
Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
Multi-objective optimization and control
Large-scale time-series forecasting (GenAI models, probabilistic forecasting, uncertainty quantification)
Causal inference (spatiotemporal causal modeling, offline policy evaluation)


Preferred Qualifications


Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
Publications in relevant venues


Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization and forecasting models for large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity, accuracy) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization or forecasting problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About The Team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications


PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field
Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience in building models for business application
Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing


Preferred Qualifications


Experience using Unix/Linux
Experience in professional software development

Title: Especialista en Inteligencia Artificial
Description:
QUIÉNES SOMOS

Fundada en 1973, en ENINTER tenemos la misión de mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas. Como líderes en fabricación, instalación y mantenimiento de ascensores, estamos comprometidos con cada una de nuestras 1000 personas colaboradoras, quienes trabajan firmemente para ofrecer el mejor servicio posible a nuestros clientes.

Hoy en día, mantenemos más de 60.000 ascensores en países como España, Italia, Suiza y Portugal.

Nuestro objetivo es claro: Ser la mejor empresa de mantenimiento de ascensores de Europa.

Si buscas un lugar donde crecer y desarrollarte profesionalmente en un ambiente colaborativo y lleno de oportunidades, ENINTER es el sitio perfecto para ti.

Sobre Nosotros

Nos sentimos orgullosos de nuestra historia y cultura, que nace de la constancia y el esfuerzo, y que nos ha llevado a donde estamos hoy. Por eso, para nuestros equipos buscamos talento que:


😊 Contribuya a un ambiente laboral positivo y colaborativo.
🚀 Esté interesado en crecer profesionalmente, comprometido con su propia proyección.
💪 Sea proactivo y constante, asumiendo la responsabilidad de sus tareas


¿CUÁL SERÁ TU MISIÓN?

Desarrollar e implantar soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning que optimicen los procesos internos de la compañía, mejoren la toma de decisiones y contribuyan a la eficiencia operativa y digitalización de la organización. acomo puente entre el área técnica y las necesidades del negocio, garantizando que las soluciones implementadas aporten valor real y sean sostenibles a largo plazo.

¿CUÁLES SERÁN TUS RESPONSABILIDADES?


Identificación de oportunidades: Analizar los procesos internos de gestión (mantenimiento, RRHH, finanzas, atención al cliente, logística, etc.) para detectar áreas donde la IA pueda aportar valor.
Desarrollo de soluciones AI: Diseñar, entrenar y desplegar modelos de IA, incluyendo automatizaciones, análisis predictivo, procesamiento de lenguaje natural, visión por computador u optimización de procesos.
Integración con sistemas existentes: Colaborar con los Project Managers de Sistemas para integrar las soluciones de IA en las plataformas corporativas (ERP, CRM, BI, herramientas internas, etc.).
Colaboración transversal: Traducir las necesidades del negocio en requerimientos técnicos y viceversa, asegurando una comunicación fluida entre áreas técnicas y operativas.
Evaluación de tecnologías: Investigar y evaluar nuevas herramientas y frameworks de IA, proponiendo soluciones viables y sostenibles para la compañía.
Gestión de datos: Colaborar con el equipo de sistemas y BI en la definición, calidad y gobernanza de los datos necesarios para los proyectos de IA.
Documentación y formación: Documentar los desarrollos y ofrecer sesiones formativas internas para facilitar la adopción de las nuevas soluciones.
Seguimiento de resultados: Definir indicadores y medir el impacto de las soluciones implementadas, proponiendo mejoras continuas.


Requisitos Mínimos


Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física o similar.
Valorable máster o especialización en Inteligencia Artificial, Data Science o Big Data.
Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en desarrollo e implementación de soluciones de IA o Machine Learning en entorno empresarial.
Experiencia colaborando con equipos técnicos y de negocio.
Valorable experiencia en entornos industriales, mantenimiento o empresas con operaciones distribuidas.


COMPETENCIAS TÉCNICAS:


Lenguajes: Python (imprescindible), SQL, y manejo de librerías como TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, etc.
Herramientas y plataformas: Azure AI, Google Cloud AI, AWS SageMaker u otras similares.
Conocimientos en automatización de procesos (RPA), NLP, visión artificial y análisis predictivo.
Bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales.
Conocimientos básicos de integración mediante APIs y arquitectura de datos.


¿QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS?


Estabilidad y crecimiento profesional: Formar parte de una empresa sólida con más de 50 años de experiencia en el sector.
Beneficios: Seguro médico privado subvencionado por la empresa.
Crecimiento: Oportunidades reales de avance profesional en un sector estable y en plena expansión.
Eninter Academy: Plan de formación interno y externo para todos nuestros técnicos, con acceso ilimitado a realizar gran parte de cursos de la oferta formativa de ENINTER.


Si te entusiasma la idea de contribuir al éxito de nuestra historia y quieres seguir desarrollándote como profesional, no dudes en enviarnos tu CV.

¡Estamos deseando conocerte!

Title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO - SnT
Description:
Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promises across hundreds of millions of packages daily? How does it decide how many trucks and how much labor are required to ship orders across the network?

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the optimization and forecasting science behind these decisions.

We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Barcelona (alternatively: Luxembourg or London) with a strong academic background in optimization, machine learning, and/or time-series forecasting.


You will design and build state-of-the-art machine learning and optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at an unprecedented scale across two core scientific pillars:
Large-Scale Optimization and Planning: Designing planning systems for order assignment and resource utilization, while balancing multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to enable controllers to steer millions of shipments per hour optimally.
Demand Forecasting & Predictive ML: Developing time-series forecasts for customer demand, incorporating contextual information (weather, sales, order properties), and modeling uncertainty for core planning systems.


Basic Qualifications


PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
Research experience in one or more:
Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
Multi-objective optimization and control
Large-scale time-series forecasting (GenAI models, probabilistic forecasting, uncertainty quantification)
Causal inference (spatiotemporal causal modeling, offline policy evaluation)


Preferred Qualifications


Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
Publications in relevant venues


Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization and forecasting models for large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity, accuracy) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization or forecasting problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About The Team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications


PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field
Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience in building models for business application
Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing


Preferred Qualifications


Experience using Unix/Linux
Experience in professional software development

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
¿Quiénes somos?




En Datision desarrollamos soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial a medida para resolver problemas reales de negocio mediante Machine Learning, Deep Learning y tecnologías avanzadas de IA.

Nacemos de un entorno fuertemente vinculado a la investigación, la innovación y el desarrollo tecnológico, y trabajamos con empresas que buscan aplicar Inteligencia Artificial a retos complejos donde no existe una solución estándar.




Nuestro día a día combina investigación aplicada, desarrollo de modelos y construcción de soluciones que llegan a producción.




Y hay algo que caracteriza especialmente a Datision: somos un equipo técnico relativamente pequeño, lo que permite que cada persona tenga un impacto real en los proyectos, participe en decisiones técnicas y pueda trabajar en problemas muy diferentes.




Buscamos incorporar un/a AI Engineer que disfrute desarrollando modelos, resolviendo problemas complejos y llevando soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial desde la experimentación hasta su aplicación real.




¿Cuál será tu misión?




Formarás parte del equipo técnico de Datision participando en el desarrollo de proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial para diferentes clientes y sectores.




No trabajarás necesariamente sobre un único problema o producto: podrás enfrentarte a distintos retos, datasets y casos de uso, participando desde el análisis inicial hasta el desarrollo, validación e integración de la solución.




Buscamos una persona con una buena base en Machine Learning y Deep Learning, criterio técnico y capacidad para seleccionar el enfoque adecuado según cada problema.




¿Qué harás?




🧠 Machine Learning & Deep Learning

Diseñar, entrenar y optimizar modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning.
Desarrollar soluciones predictivas a partir de datos reales.
Analizar datasets complejos e identificar patrones relevantes.
Trabajar con problemas de clasificación, regresión, detección de anomalías, forecasting u otros casos de uso según el proyecto.
Realizar feature engineering y preparación de datos para modelado.
Seleccionar algoritmos y arquitecturas en función de las características del problema.
Definir métricas, validar resultados y comparar diferentes aproximaciones.
Optimizar modelos existentes y analizar su comportamiento.




🚀 IA aplicada

Participar en proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial para diferentes sectores y clientes.
Convertir necesidades de negocio en problemas abordables mediante Machine Learning.
Investigar y probar nuevas aproximaciones cuando el problema lo requiera.
Participar en el diseño técnico de las soluciones.
Trabajar con Machine Learning clásico, Deep Learning y, cuando aporte valor, tecnologías de IA Generativa.




🤖 IA Generativa

Participar en proyectos que incorporen LLMs, RAG, AI Agents u otras tecnologías de IA Generativa.
Integrar modelos de lenguaje dentro de soluciones y aplicaciones.
Evaluar diferentes modelos, herramientas y arquitecturas según las necesidades de cada proyecto.




La IA Generativa es una tecnología más dentro del stack: buscamos un perfil con una base sólida en Machine Learning, no exclusivamente especializado en LLMs.

⚙️ Producción e integración

Llevar modelos desde la experimentación hasta entornos productivos.
Desarrollar APIs y servicios para integrar modelos en aplicaciones.
Participar en pipelines de procesamiento e inferencia.
Colaborar en despliegues cloud y arquitecturas escalables.
Trabajar conjuntamente con otros perfiles técnicos durante todo el ciclo de vida de las soluciones.




¿Qué buscamos?

Imprescindible

Experiencia profesional desarrollando soluciones de Machine Learning / Inteligencia Artificial.
Experiencia real entrenando modelos para resolver problemas de negocio.
Buen conocimiento de Machine Learning clásico.
Experiencia con Deep Learning.
Dominio de Python.
Experiencia con Scikit-Learn y al menos un framework de Deep Learning como PyTorch o TensorFlow.
Capacidad para analizar un problema y seleccionar el algoritmo o arquitectura más adecuada.
Experiencia evaluando modelos mediante métricas y procesos de validación.
Experiencia trabajando con datos reales y llevando desarrollos más allá de la fase puramente experimental.
Español fluido, necesario para la comunicación diaria con el equipo y clientes.
Disponibilidad para trabajar en modelo híbrido en Terrassa.




Valoraremos especialmente

Experiencia con XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, Random Forest u otros algoritmos de Machine Learning.
Experiencia con forecasting, series temporales, anomaly detection o predictive modeling.
Conocimientos de MLOps y ciclo de vida de modelos.
Experiencia desarrollando APIs con FastAPI.
Experiencia con AWS, Azure o GCP.
Docker, CI/CD y herramientas de versionado y monitorización de modelos.
Experiencia con LLMs, RAG y AI Agents.
Haber trabajado en consultoría tecnológica, startups o entornos donde se desarrollen diferentes proyectos de IA.




¿Qué buscamos en la persona?

Nos gustaría encontrar a alguien que:

Disfrute enfrentándose a problemas diferentes y técnicamente complejos.
Tenga curiosidad y ganas de seguir aprendiendo.
No se limite a aplicar un algoritmo, sino que quiera entender por qué funciona y cuándo utilizarlo.
Sea capaz de combinar rigor técnico con pragmatismo.
Tenga autonomía y capacidad para proponer soluciones.
Se sienta cómodo trabajando en un equipo técnico cercano.
Quiera participar en las decisiones y tener impacto real en los proyectos.




🚀 ¿Qué ofrecemos?

🧠 Trabajar en proyectos reales de Inteligencia Artificial, enfrentándote a problemas y sectores diferentes.

🔬 Un entorno con una fuerte cultura de innovación, investigación aplicada y desarrollo tecnológico.

📈 La posibilidad de trabajar con Machine Learning, Deep Learning e IA Generativa, seleccionando la tecnología en función del problema y no al revés.

🤝 Formar parte de un equipo técnico cercano, donde tendrás contacto directo con las personas que toman las decisiones y tus aportaciones tendrán impacto.

🌱 Aprendizaje continuo gracias a la variedad de proyectos, tecnologías y problemas.

  • Desarrollar soluciones predictivas a partir de datos reales.
  • Analizar datasets complejos e identificar patrones relevantes.

  • Participar en proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial para diferentes sectores y clientes.
  • Convertir necesidades de negocio en problemas abordables mediante Machine Learning.
  • Investigar y probar nuevas aproximaciones cuando el problema lo requiera.
  • Participar en el diseño técnico de las soluciones.

  • Integrar modelos de lenguaje dentro de soluciones y aplicaciones.

⚙️ Producción e integración

  • Desarrollar APIs y servicios para integrar modelos en aplicaciones.
  • Participar en pipelines de procesamiento e inferencia.

  • Trabajar conjuntamente con otros perfiles técnicos durante todo el ciclo de vida de las soluciones.

Analizar y explorar grandes conjuntos de datos para identificar patrones, tendencias y oportunidades.

Analizar aspectos relacionados con sesgos, explicabilidad y robustez de los modelos.
Trabajar con técnicas de Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP y series temporales.
Generar visualizaciones y comunicar los resultados de los análisis.
Traducir los resultados obtenidos en conclusiones y recomendaciones de negocio.
Colaborar con otros equipos en la industrialización y puesta en producción de modelos.
Participar en la mejora continua de modelos y soluciones analíticas.

Experiencia profesional como Data Scientist, Machine Learning Scientist o posición similar.

Capacidad para comunicar resultados técnicos de forma clara.
Orientación a negocio y capacidad para traducir análisis de datos en recomendaciones.

Experiencia en NLP (Natural Language Processing).
Experiencia con series temporales.
Experiencia en diseño y ejecución de experimentos.

Experiencia en análisis de sesgos y robustez de modelos.
Experiencia en visualización de datos.

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more industry segments.

We invest in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries. Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland. Learn more at experianplc.com.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to play a pivotal role in our growing EMAP Data Science team. This position is ideal for an accomplished professional passionate about advanced analytics, innovation, and delivering impactful solutions to clients.

Role Purpose

The primary goal of this role is to design, develop, and deliver innovative data science solutions that address complex business challenges and create measurable value for our clients. The successful candidate will combine expertise in programming, data engineering, statistical modelling, machine learning, and Generative AI to transform data into actionable insights and scalable solutions.

Working closely with clients and internal stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, strengthen strategic relationships, and develop analytical products and prototypes that support data-driven decision making and business growth. You will leverage large and diverse datasets, anticipate challenges, and deliver high-quality solutions that generate tangible impact.

Responsibilities


Evaluate and acquire new data assets
Develop new product prototypes
Provide sales support and consultancy
Analyze, and document large datasets
Apply machine learning, data mining, and text mining techniques to extract value from data
Validate model and score performance
Document and present modeling processes and outcomes
Design analytical solutions for internal and external clients to address business problems. Design and deliver scalable analytics and AI solutions for internal and external clients to solve complex business challenges.
Make independent decisions to develop new approaches and resolve uncertainty in complex scenarios
Establish best practices for applying Experian and client data to create insights
Define business assumptions for relevant solutions
Create materials for knowledge sharing and roundtable discussions
Lead programs to enhance client analytical solutions, data quality, model performance, and project timelines
Guide team efforts to identify solutions
Share expertise and improve departmental contributions
Provide mentoring within project teams
Advocate for analytics through publications and presentations
Proficiency in Python
Understanding of data structures and their applications in marketing, risk, and customer management
Familiarity with regression models, XGBoost, neural networks, SVM, and ensemble methods
3+ years of experience in defining scope and delivering customized analytics projects
Expertise in advanced algorithms to solve practical business problems


Qualifications


Statistics
Computer Science
Machine Learning
AI
Programming
Python

You will get:


Personal Development - career pathway for professional growth supported by learning and development programs and unlimited access to online educational training courses, learning materials and books.

Social benefit package including food vouchers, health insurance, monthly flex allowance and internet coverage, Sharesave plan, Employee assistance program, and many other benefits!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos un/a Data Scientist que convierta datos en decisiones de alto impacto para REVEL en un momento clave de su crecimiento.

Buscamos a alguien con sólida base estadística, experiencia construyendo modelos predictivos y obsesión por llevar soluciones analíticas del notebook a producción.

El equipo de datos en REVEL es transversal y crítico. Soporta decisiones de negocio, alimenta herramientas operativas (pricing, scoring, finanzas) y es la base sobre la que escala la compañía. Tu misión será diseñar y desplegar modelos de Machine Learning que resuelvan problemas reales del negocio: predecir demanda, optimizar precios, anticipar churn y mejorar la toma de decisiones en toda la organización.

El equipo

Te integrarás en un equipo de datos de 10 personas organizado en tres áreas, colaborando directamente con todas ellas:

Data Engineering Pipelines, orquestación, ETLs, automatizaciones y observabilidad de datos. Stack: Airflow


Fivetran
AWS Glue
Lambdas
RDS
Datadog


Data Governance Calidad del dato, catálogo, tests y ownership del DG score corporativo. Stack: dbt


OpenMetadata
Power BI


Data Analytics Arquitectura dbt, dashboards corporativos y herramientas analíticas clave (pricer, OCR, lead scoring, reporting financiero). Stack: dbt


Python
Lambdas
Power BI


Responsabilidades Principales


Diseñar, entrenar y desplegar modelos de Machine Learning/Advanced Analytics (predicción de demanda, churn, pricing dinámico, scoring de clientes) integrados en los flujos de negocio.
Realizar análisis estadísticos avanzados y diseñar experimentos (A/B testing, inferencia causal) para medir el impacto de iniciativas de producto, marketing y operaciones.
Explorar y segmentar datos para identificar oportunidades de mejora en la experiencia de suscripción, la gestión de flota y la retención de clientes.
Comunicar conclusiones y recomendaciones de forma clara a stakeholders no técnicos mediante visualizaciones.
Colaborar estrechamente con Data Engineering y Analytics para garantizar la disponibilidad y calidad de los datos que alimentan los modelos.
Contribuir a la definición del roadmap de iniciativas de ciencia de datos alineado con los objetivos de la compañía.


Requisitos

Must


>3 años de experiencia como Data Scientist o en un rol analítico avanzado con foco en Ciencia de datos.
Dominio de Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) y R, SQL medio.
Experiencia práctica con técnicas de Machine Learning supervisado y no supervisado.
Sólida base en estadística e inferencia (tests de hipótesis, regresión, diseño experimental).
Capacidad para llevar modelos del notebook a producción.
Comunicación clara con stakeholders no técnicos (negocio, finanzas, operaciones).


Nice To Have


Conocimiento de herramientas de MLOps (MLflow, SageMaker) o experiencia desplegando modelos en AWS.
Background en sectores con operaciones complejas: movilidad, fintech, logística o similares.
Experiencia con modelos de series temporales y optimización.
Familiaridad con dbt, Airflow o herramientas del stack de datos de REVEL.
Inglés fluido.


Qué Ofrecemos


Rol con ownership real de la capa de ciencia de datos de REVEL. Integración directa en el equipo de datos.
Autonomía para proponer, diseñar y ejecutar iniciativas de modelado.
Salario competitivo acorde a la responsabilidad del puesto.
Modelo híbrido con oficina en Madrid centro (presencia mínima de 2 días/semana).
Flexibilidad horaria real y cultura orientada a resultados.
Descuento exclusivo en la suscripción de nuestra flota.
Wellhub (Gympass) – Plan Silver.
Seguro médico Cigna.
Presupuesto anual para formación.
Remuneración flexible (Payflow).
23 días de vacaciones + tu cumpleaños libre.
Revisiones de performance periódicas.
Gran momento para unirte a REVEL durante su expansión.


Proceso De Selección


Charla inicial con RRHH Conversación para conocer tu perfil, resolver dudas y confirmar encaje con el proyecto.
Reunión técnica con el Head of Data Profundizamos en tu experiencia con modelado, estadística y los retos del rol. Online o presencial.
Caso práctico Un ejercicio técnico acotado para ver cómo piensas y resuelves problemas con datos.
Fase final con el CTO


Olvídate del papeleo, las entradas imposibles y las permanencias del renting tradicional. En REVEL hemos transformado el acceso al vehículo con un modelo de suscripción de coches 100% digital, flexible y con todo incluido.

Somos una startup tecnológica en pleno crecimiento y con una misión clara: hacer que tener coche sea tan fácil como suscribirte a tu plataforma de series favorita. Si buscas un proyecto donde pisar el acelerador desde el primer día, este es tu sitio.

Title: Senior Data Scientist – AI Labs
Description:
In a few words




Position: Senior Data Scientist – AI Labs

Location: Madrid (Chamberí area).




Want to know more? 👇




INSUD PHARMA operates across the entire pharmaceutical value chain, providing specialized knowledge and experience in scientific research, development, manufacturing, sales, and marketing of a wide range of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), finished dosage forms (FDF), and branded pharmaceutical products, adding value to human and animal health.




The activities of INSUD PHARMA are organized into three synergistic business areas: Industrial (Chemo), Branded (Exeltis), and Biotech (Bionanopharma), with over 10,000 professionals in more than 50 countries, 20 state-of-the-art facilities, 15 specialized R&D centers, 12 commercial offices, and more than 35 pharmaceutical subsidiaries, serving 1,150 customers in 96 countries worldwide. INSUD PHARMA believes in innovation and sustainable development.




Ready to be a #Challenger?




What are we looking for? 🔎




We're the Data Science team at AI Labs, the applied AI department of Insud Pharma, a global pharmaceutical group. Around 30 people (Data Scientists, AI Engineers, DevOps, Product Managers) building models and products across the whole pharma value chain: R&D, chemical synthesis, manufacturing, clinical operations, supply chain, pricing. Small teams, fast iteration, real ownership.




The challenge!




Own a problem end to end: frame it with the business, choose the methodology, build the solution, validate it rigorously and take it to production.
Work in a small squad, typically you, a Product Manager and an Engineer, plus the key stakeholders. Short feedback loops; your work is visible from day one.
Move between problems and business areas. Projects vary in domain and technical approach, and you'll often have more than one in motion at a time. This is not a single-domain role.
Turn results into decisions: present technical trade-offs and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and defend every methodological choice.




What do you need?




5+ years as a Data Scientist in industry, having taken projects from problem framing to deployment.
Breadth over domain depth: hands-on experience with several of these in real projects: predictive ML, forecasting, causal inference, experimentation, optimization, clustering, graphs, deep learning. We value people whose work generalizes across domains rather than one vertical (fraud, marketing, credit…).
Rigorous by default: you can justify every technical decision and know when a simpler method beats a fancy one.
Autonomous. You'll be the main contributor on your project, carrying the technical work and driving decisions day to day, with the Data Science team and its lead as a sounding board rather than a safety net.
Strong communicator: you've presented to stakeholders and shaped decisions with your analysis.
Genuine curiosity for the field: you read, you experiment, maybe you have side projects.
Solid Python and software engineering habits (clean code, Git, testing). Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) and familiarity with LLMs are a plus.
Professional Spanish and English.




Why here




Startup mindset, corporate backing: autonomy, flat structure and fast decisions, with the data, scale and stability of a large pharma group behind you.
Problems that matter: what you build ends up in factories, labs and clinical teams.
A team that learns together: demo days, whiteboard sessions, honest feedback.
Central Madrid office (Chamberí, near Eloy Gonzalo), hybrid model, flexible start time.
Permanent contract, ticket restaurant, life & accident insurance, training and language platform, wellness platform with unlimited psychologist sessions, Cabify for employees, development plans and internal mobility.




Our benefits!




⏰ Flexible start time from Monday to Friday

📜 Permanent contract.

🥼 Life and accident insurance.

🍽️ Ticket restaurant

💻 Training and language learning platform

💆🏻 ♀️ Wellness platform with unlimited free psychologist sessions

🚕 Cabify transportation service for employee use

📈 Development plans, internal mobility policy.

⭐ Many more!




🔷 Do you think this offer is not for you? 🔷




Follow us on social media like LinkedIn/Instagram and stay tuned for any offers we may release; the opportunity to be a new Insuder is waiting!

The InsudPharma group is aware that business management must align with the needs and demands of society, and therefore assumes the commitment to equal opportunities and treatment between men and women, as stated in the current regulations on the matter - Organic Law 3/2007, and we do not discriminate against any person on the grounds of ethnicity, religion, age, sex, nationality, marital status, affective or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or any other personal or social circumstance.

Integración en un equipo multidisciplinar

Centro de trabajo en Oviedo o Vigo
Contrato indefinido

Una política de RRHH que permitirá la integración perfecta de tu vida personal. Política de teletrabajo muy extendida en la Compañía, tendrás una modalidad de trabajo híbrido.
Horario flexible, con jornada continua todos los viernes. Horario de verano durante 4 meses con jornada continua de L-V,
Disfrutarás de 22 días laborables de vacaciones, más el día de nochebuena o nochevieja. El día que no disfrutes aprovecharemos para tomar algo y brindar a nuestra salud.
Descuentos exclusivos en multitud de servicios y productos (viajes, automóvil, moda, tiempo libre, deporte, cultura, hogar, tecnología, gastronomía…) a través de la plataforma Corporate Benefits.

Podrás optar a los siguientes servicios: Seguro Médico (Sanitas, IMQ o Caser), incluyendo familiares; Cheque/Tarjeta Gourmet; Tarjeta Transporte; Cheque guardería.
Existe también un plan de incentivos muy interesante si nos ayudas a encontrar a profesionales como tú.
Como aquí ayudamos a buscar/inventar nuevos proyectos, también existe un plan de recompensa por captación de negocio.
Bolsa de apoyo a estudios reglados.
Te ayudamos con los idiomas, porque es muy posible que los necesites (inglés y francés).
Formación presencial y online, para que puedas mantenerte al día y a tu ritmo.
Organización donde todas las puertas están abiertas de verdad.


Requisitos:


Titulación en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería, Informática, Física o disciplinas afines.
Experiencia en análisis estadístico y modelización de datos.
Dominio de Python para análisis de datos y desarrollo de modelos (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).
Conocimientos sólidos de SQL, bases de datos relacionales y NoSQL, especializadas en series temporales de datos, documentales, grafos...
Experiencia con Spark, Databricks o entornos Big Data.
Experiencia en creación y uso de Datalakes y Datalakehouse con herramientas y frameworks opensource (Apache Iceberg, Project Nessie, Trino, Apache Polaris, …).
Experiencia en implementación de arquitectura Medallón.
Conocimientos de ingeniería de datos y procesos ETL.
Experiencia en preparación, limpieza y transformación de datos.
Experiencia en análisis y procesamiento de información geospacial en diferentes formatos.
Capacidad para visualizar datos y comunicar resultados mediante herramientas como Power BI, Tableau o similares.
Experiencia en técnicas de Machine Learning supervisado y no supervisado.
Conocimiento de metodologías de validación y evaluación de modelos.
Manejo de Git y buenas prácticas de desarrollo colaborativo.


Se valorará:


Experiencia con Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Conocimientos de IA Generativa y modelos de lenguaje (LLMs).
Experiencia con herramientas de MLOps y despliegue de modelos.
Conocimientos de arquitecturas cloud (Azure, AWS o Google Cloud).
Certificaciones en Data Science, IA o plataformas cloud.

Title: Global Data Scientist Specialist
Description:
WHO WE ARE

Avolta is the world’s leading travel experience player. With a traveler-centric philosophy and a geographically diverse network, the travel retail and F&B company addresses the needs of up to 2.3 billion passengers each year, with 5,500 outlets in more than 75 countries across six continents. Guided by their Destination 2027 strategy and boosted by their recent combination with travel F&B giant Autogrill, the company is well positioned to realize their ambition to create a Travel Experience Revolution through their many locations at airports, motorways, cruise lines, seaports and railway stations amongst others.




PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Global Data Scientist Specialist will leverage advanced analytics and data science to unlock insights that drive strategic decisions and operational excellence across Avolta’s global IT landscape. This role is pivotal in transforming complex data into actionable intelligence, enabling innovation and supporting the company’s vision of revolutionizing the travel experience. This role will be based in Madrid with hybrid flexibility.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Identifies emerging analytic trends, data needs, and innovative solutions to address business challenges
Collaborates with the Analytics Business Analysts and key stakeholders to generate hypotheses and develop models that answer impactful business questions
Design and implement statistical models to extract meaningful insights from large datasets
Parses, cleanses, and manipulates structured and unstructured data for analysis
Conduct quality assurance testing to ensure accuracy and reliability of models
Works with data sourcing teams to develop, test, implement, and maintain analytic models, including attribute identification, exploratory data analysis, and data transformation
Partners with business teams to review data sources, resolve inconsistencies, and validate business logic for data discovery initiatives
Performs advanced text, quantitative, statistical, financial, and operational analyses.
Designs, builds, and scales end-to-end ML pipelines, enabling efficient data processing, model training, deployment, and monitoring in production environments




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience: Proven track record in data modeling using leading analytics tools and relational data structures
Technical Skills: Strong programming skills in Python, PySpark and SQL, with solid understanding of databases, data modeling, and data structures
Machine Learning Expertise: Strong foundation in machine learning techniques, including model selection, performance evaluation, and validation; experience with model explainability, interpretability, and auditability to ensure transparency and reliability in production environments
Big Data & Cloud: Hands-on experience with modern cloud-based data platforms, such as Databricks and familiarity with scalable data architecture
Collaboration: Ability to work cross-functionally with IT, business analysts, and data teams
Communication Skills: Strong communication and storytelling abilities, with a clear focus on translating complex analytical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders and business users
Languages: Fluent English (spoken and written)
Personal Competences: Team worker, able to lead and support others, and contribute to growth within a collaborative and agile team environment
Data Product Mindset: Experience delivering end-to-end data products, from data ingestion and modeling to deployment and business adoption
Visualization Skills: Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI, to effectively communicate insights and support decision-making

Senior Data Scientist (They/She/He) - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our team in Barcelona. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

You will have the opportunity to crunch massive datasets using the latest Big Data technologies as well as solve problems using state of the art AI algorithms. You will have the chance to debate and explore new ideas, approaches and technologies with your team to design and implement the best solutions. We follow the philosophy of using the right tool for the right job and are not afraid to explore the greenfield. You will be a key player in the organisation; designing and implementing advanced analytics and using machine learning to build AI powered solutions for almost every area in the business like online fraud detection, recommendation engines, user experience personalization, optimising the flight combinations we offer or the marketing campaigns we launch, and virtually every possible area subject to optimization in the business. Join us and help us reach our ambitious goal of becoming the global leader in online travel!

Within the Data Science team, we are focussed on researching and building cutting-edge solutions to evolve better travel experiences for our customers, all by leveraging the information from over 30 million searches that we receive everyday! Due to this scale, we are able to have a wider and better selection of travel plans that are tailored to suit the traveller’s needs which is probably more than any other travel site.. Machine learning models in production make over 1.8 Billion predictions a day improving customer experience and helping drive better decisions in an ever changing environment. The team is constantly evolving the next generation of models using cutting edge algorithms and technology to improve our goals to drive value for our customers.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.


20 million customers – 44 markets – 5 brands – 6.5M members in Prime
16.2 million bookings FY23 - More than 50,000 bookings per day - 100 million daily user searches
8 Billion ML predictions per day - Up to 1.8 billion daily AI predictions[e1]
1400 employees – More than 50 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age



We're a leading travel tech company, revolutionising the travel booking experience through our consumer insight, innovative technology, market leadership, and Prime, the world's first travel subscription program.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Data Scientist in the Data Science team, you will be in charge of:


Work with multi-disciplinary teams and key stakeholders to drive value and growth for both our customers and business.
Take ownership of initiatives and ensure successful delivery from initiation to final outcome.
Provide transparency on initiatives to the team and stakeholders.
Influence and advice stakeholders on the best course of action.
Keep up-to-date on the advancements in the area of machine learning and AI.
Lead and mentor data scientists.
Act as an evangelist for machine learning and AI.
Adhere to company values, create and maintain a friendly working environment.



What you need to succeed:

Job Requirements

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering or other quantitative fields);
5+ years of related experience as a Data Scientist, AI expert or Machine Learning engineer;
A solid understanding of relevant statistical, data processing and machine learning methods and their implementation using standard open source frameworks;
Experienced with building production ready machine learning solutions and MLOps;
Experienced Python developer. Other programming languages are a plus;
Experience with cloud platforms and scalable solutions;
Experience creating solutions powered by Generative AI, specially Large Language Models, and LLM frameworks like LangChain will be a plus;
Written and oral communication skills (in English).



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.
